biography.ja: フランス・ラ・フレーシュに生まれ、アダンに師事した。パリ音楽院やパリ・オペラ座のオルガニストを務めながら作曲を続け、それまで娯楽的な添え物とみなされがちだったバレエ音楽を、単独で鑑賞に堪える芸術作品の域にまで高めた作曲家として知られる。
biography.en: Born in La Flèche, France, he studied under Adolphe Adam. While working as an organist at the Paris Conservatoire and the Paris Opera, he continued to compose, and he is known as the composer who elevated ballet music, previously often regarded as mere entertainment, to the level of a serious, independently appreciable art form.

style.ja: フランス的な洗練とオーケストラの色彩感覚を存分に生かし、旋律の魅力と舞踊のための的確なリズム感を両立させた。オペラでもエキゾチックな異国情緒を効果的に取り入れ、特に東洋を舞台とした代表作では、旋律美と劇的な緊張感を巧みに組み合わせている。
style.en: He made full use of French refinement and orchestral color to balance melodic appeal with a rhythmic precision suited to dance. In opera too he effectively drew on exotic, foreign atmosphere, and in his best-known opera set in the East he skillfully combined melodic beauty with dramatic tension.

impact.ja: その代表的なバレエ音楽は、後にチャイコフスキーが自身のバレエ音楽を手がける際の直接的な模範として名指しで称賛したことで知られ、フランスのバレエ音楽がロシア・バレエの発展に与えた影響を象徴する存在となった。今日でも「三大バレエ」と称されるチャイコフスキーの作品群の背後には、彼が切り拓いたバレエ音楽の芸術的地位向上という前提が存在する。
impact.en: His best-known ballet score is known for having been explicitly singled out and praised by Tchaikovsky as a direct model when he himself came to compose ballet music, making him a symbol of French ballet music's influence on the development of Russian ballet. Behind Tchaikovsky's works, often called the "three great ballets" today, lies the premise of the elevated artistic status that he had pioneered for ballet music.

ja: バレエ音楽を芸術の域に高めた功績
チャイコフスキーが模範と称賛
東洋を舞台にした代表的オペラ
en: Elevated ballet music to serious art
Explicitly praised as a model by Tchaikovsky
Best-known opera set in the East
